+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions"
+OPENAI_MODEL = "gpt-5.4-mini"
+
+
+def _build_prompt(label: str, note: str) -> str:
+    return (
+        "Check the following secret label and note for unsafe text. "
+        "Unsafe text includes secrets, credentials, tokens, passwords, "
+        "malware instructions, exfiltration guidance, or abusive content. "
+        "Return JSON with keys unsafe (boolean), reasons (array of strings), and summary (string).\n\n"
+        f"Label: {label}\n"
+        f"Note: {note}"
+    )
+
+
+def check_secret_label_safety(label: str, note: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    api_key = api_key or os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_API_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json={
+            "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+            "messages": [
+                {"role": "system", "content": "You are a safety classifier."},
+                {"role": "user", "content": _build_prompt(label, note)},
+            ],
+            "temperature": 0,
+            "response_format": {"type": "json_object"},
+        },
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    content = data["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
+    return json.loads(content)
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    import argparse
+
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("label")
+    parser.add_argument("note")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    print(json.dumps(check_secret_label_safety(args.label, args.note), ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

+import os
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+import requests
+
+
+TWILIO_ACCOUNTS_API = "https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts.json"
+
+
+def _twilio_auth():
+    sid = os.environ.get("TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID")
+    token = os.environ.get("TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN")
+    if not sid or not token:
+        raise RuntimeError("TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID and TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN are required")
+    return sid, token
+
+
+def _fetch_twilio_accounts():
+    sid, token = _twilio_auth()
+    response = requests.get(TWILIO_ACCOUNTS_API, auth=(sid, token), timeout=30)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    payload = response.json()
+    return payload.get("accounts", [])
+
+
+def _rotation_status(account):
+    created = account.get("date_created")
+    friendly_name = account.get("friendly_name") or account.get("sid")
+    status = account.get("status", "unknown")
+    if created:
+        try:
+            created_dt = datetime.strptime(created, "%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S %z")
+            age_days = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - created_dt.astimezone(timezone.utc)).days
+        except Exception:
+            age_days = None
+    else:
+        age_days = None
+    return {
+        "name": friendly_name,
+        "status": status,
+        "age_days": age_days,
+    }
+
+
+def summarize_secret_rotation():
+    accounts = _fetch_twilio_accounts()
+    summaries = [_rotation_status(account) for account in accounts]
+    if not summaries:
+        return "No Twilio accounts found; secret rotation status unavailable."
+    lines = ["Twilio secret rotation summary:"]
+    for item in summaries:
+        age_text = f"{item['age_days']} days old" if item["age_days"] is not None else "age unknown"
+        lines.append(f"- {item['name']}: status={item['status']}, {age_text}")
+    return "\n".join(lines)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    print(summarize_secret_rotation())
*** End Patch

*** Add File: security_models.py
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from typing import Any, Mapping
+import base64
+import hashlib
+import json
+import re
+
+
+_SECRET_KEYS = {
+    "secret",
+    "password",
+    "passwd",
+    "token",
+    "apikey",
+    "api_key",
+    "access_key",
+    "private_key",
+    "client_secret",
+    "credential",
+}
+
+_SENSITIVE_PATTERNS = [
+    re.compile(r"(^|[_\-])(secret|password|passwd|token|key|credential)s?($|[_\-])", re.IGNORECASE),
+    re.compile(r"bearer\s+[a-z0-9._\-+/=]+", re.IGNORECASE),
+    re.compile(r"(?i)-----BEGIN [A-Z ]+PRIVATE KEY-----"),
+]
+
+
+def _now_utc() -> datetime:
+    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)
+
+
+def _stable_json(value: Any) -> str:
+    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False, default=str)
+
+
+def _looks_sensitive_name(name: str) -> bool:
+    n = name.lower()
+    return any(key in n for key in _SECRET_KEYS) or any(pattern.search(n) for pattern in _SENSITIVE_PATTERNS)
+
+
+def _mask_scalar(value: Any) -> Any:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, bool):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, bytes):
+        return "[REDACTED-BYTES]"
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        if not value:
+            return value
+        if any(pattern.search(value) for pattern in _SENSITIVE_PATTERNS):
+            return "[REDACTED]"
+        if len(value) > 64:
+            return f"[REDACTED:{hashlib.sha256(value.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()[:12]}]"
+        return value
+    return "[REDACTED]"
+
+
+def normalize_secret_value(value: Any) -> Any:
+    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        return {str(k): normalize_secret_value(v) for k, v in value.items()}
+    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple, set)):
+        return [normalize_secret_value(v) for v in value]
+    return _mask_scalar(value)
+
+
+def normalize_secret_payload(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    normalized: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    for key, value in payload.items():
+        key_str = str(key)
+        normalized[key_str] = "[REDACTED]" if _looks_sensitive_name(key_str) else normalize_secret_value(value)
+    return normalized
+
+
+def build_secret_request(name: str, value: Any, metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    request = {
+        "name": name,
+        "value": value,
+        "metadata": dict(metadata or {}),
+        "created_at": _now_utc().isoformat(),
+    }
+    request["value_fingerprint"] = hashlib.sha256(_stable_json(normalize_secret_value(value)).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
+    return request
+
+
+def build_secret_response(name: str, secret_id: str, status: str = "stored", metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {
+        "name": name,
+        "secret_id": secret_id,
+        "status": status,
+        "metadata": dict(metadata or {}),
+        "timestamp": _now_utc().isoformat(),
+    }
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class SecretRequest:
+    name: str
+    value: Any
+    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: _now_utc().isoformat())
+
+    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        return build_secret_request(self.name, self.value, self.metadata)
+
+    def normalized(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        return normalize_secret_payload(self.to_dict())
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class SecretResponse:
+    name: str
+    secret_id: str
+    status: str = "stored"
+    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    timestamp: str = field(default_factory=lambda: _now_utc().isoformat())
+
+    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        return build_secret_response(self.name, self.secret_id, self.status, self.metadata)
+
+    def normalized(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        return normalize_secret_payload(self.to_dict())
+
+
+def redact_secrets(obj: Any) -> Any:
+    if isinstance(obj, Mapping):
+        return {str(k): ("[REDACTED]" if _looks_sensitive_name(str(k)) else redact_secrets(v)) for k, v in obj.items()}
+    if isinstance(obj, list):
+        return [redact_secrets(v) for v in obj]
+    if isinstance(obj, tuple):
+        return tuple(redact_secrets(v) for v in obj)
+    if isinstance(obj, set):
+        return {redact_secrets(v) for v in obj}
+    return _mask_scalar(obj)
+
+
+def secret_digest(value: Any) -> str:
+    normalized = _stable_json(normalize_secret_value(value)).encode("utf-8")
+    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(hashlib.sha256(normalized).digest()).decode("ascii").rstrip("=")
*** End Patch
